name: content-hub-verifykit
note: Scoped to the WeChat article pipeline owned by the 2026-09-28 iteration. The repository root also holds unrelated legacy tooling (etf-quant, book_research, synthesize_weekly, ...) that is out of scope and would otherwise produce noise. Vendored/cache directories are excluded.

rules.description: Production code must not import fixtures, mocks or test data.
Empty catch blocks and empty except/pass hide failures.
Fallbacks must go through the VerifyKit degrade mechanism.
